name: desktop
text:
SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE SUPPORTS THE RESURRECTION · MIKE WINGER
"jesus did in fact die by crucifixion"

Winger states the crucifixion as the shared historical starting point accepted for the debate, not as proof that a resurrection subsequently occurred.

name: desktop
text:
THE EVIDENCE IS INSUFFICIENT TO ESTABLISH THE RESURRECTION · PAULOGIA
"history ultimately isn't a vote"

Paulogia acknowledges the relevance of specialist judgment while insisting that listeners still need the underlying arguments, sources, and sampling basis rather than a reported scholarly tally.
